steps.what: Presenter route POST /api/gcsp/appointments/complete refused (409). The browser has no completion control.
steps.repeatedBy: 'FUCQ-171 manual handoff lifecycle' step 3 and 'no-show then rebooking' step 6

steps.what: Paula acknowledges the agreement with Tab and Enter (the only document task she owns).

Presenter route POST /api/gcsp/appointments/complete (200). The readiness time is reached by a service tick in this runner; the presenter strip Tick controls drive the same clock (the FUCQ-124 walkthrough clicks them).
Presenter route POST /api/gcsp/appointments/no-show (200). The browser has no no-show control.
Paula rebooks with Tab and Enter on the first offered slot.
Retailer confirmation is a service tick; completion is the presenter route. No PNG: the completed state is captured in 02.

Return outcome is the policy key lifecycle.return.outcome.v1 (enabled and set to returned before boot) acting on the keyed delay after the slot; handover completion is the presenter route. The browser has neither.
The missed outcome is the policy key lifecycle.return.outcome.v1 (enabled, missed, before boot) acting on its keyed delay; no browser control.
One service tick runs the renewal-risk rule that opens the owned case (renewalCase.lifecycle.eventTypes).
Greg picks the case and opens it with Tab, a type-ahead select and Enter on /gcsp-case-queue.html.

Setup: reset, briefs, release, the real first offer opened from its outbox link and declined for body style over the offer routes, then a presenter tick to one week before the contract end. These are the setup steps of the e2e test.
Paula asks, reviews and confirms on /gcsp-help.html with Tab and Enter.
Greg moves the case to In progress, then to Remedy proposed with one body-style change, with Tab, type-ahead selects and Enter on /gcsp-case-queue.html (FUCQ-122 remainder).
Paula reviews and confirms the single change on /gcsp-help.html (POST /api/gcsp/brief/change-after-decline). The control exists.
Greg resolves the confirmed case on /gcsp-case-queue.html with Tab, type-ahead selects and Enter, keeping the confirmed remedy.
Paula reloads /gcsp-help.html and reads the persisted outcome.
